title: Definitions.
bodyText:
As used in this chapter:

"Department" means the department of commerce and consumer affairs.

"Design professional" means a professional engineer, architect, surveyor, or landscape architect licensed under chapter 464.

"Director" means the director of commerce and consumer affairs.
bodyHtml:
[§672B-1]  Definitions.  As used in this chapter:

     "Department" means the department of commerce and consumer affairs.

     "Design professional" means a professional engineer, architect, surveyor, or landscape architect licensed under chapter 464.

     "Director" means the director of commerce and consumer affairs. [L 2007, c 207, pt of §2]
